scenario.task_instruction: Handle this synthetic intraoperative pathology workflow using the available records, messages, procedures, and tools. Decide independently which information and actions are relevant. You may call finish whenever you consider the case resolved.

metadata.task_goal: Establish a current documented handoff for a preliminary frozen-section finding using the operative request, specimen record, and pathology evidence.

files./workspace/pathology/request.txt:
OPERATIVE REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-1901
The operating room requests communication regarding a frozen section from a left thyroid nodule. The case reference is OR-V3-1901 and the surgeon is waiting for pathology contact.
files./workspace/pathology/current_record.txt:
CURRENT OPERATIVE RECORD
Patient ID: PAT-V3-1901
The specimen was received during hemithyroidectomy. The operative note identifies the question as whether there is a finding that would alter the extent of surgery. The procedure remains in progress.
files./workspace/pathology/specimen.txt:
SPECIMEN MATERIAL
The accession record lists 'left thyroid nodule, frozen section' and matches the patient identifier and operating-room reference. A grossing note records one small irregular fragment with a separately submitted margin specimen still pending accession.
files./workspace/pathology/evidence.txt:
PATHOLOGY EVIDENCE
The frozen-section worksheet documents atypical follicular proliferation and notes that definitive capsule and vascular assessment is deferred to permanent sections. A preliminary phone note template is blank. No final pathology report has been signed.
files./workspace/pathology/procedure.md:
WORKSPACE NOTE
The workspace includes an operative request, current record, specimen material, and pathology evidence. Source timing, authorship, and scope may differ.
